card.summary: Anonymous forever $0 - No account required - Random ephemeral hostname - 1 active tunnel - 512 MiB per tunnel. Registered Free forever - 1 reserved hostname ...

free_tier.stated: Anonymous forever $0 - No account required - Random ephemeral hostname - 1 active tunnel - 512 MiB per tunnel. Registered Free forever - 1 reserved hostname - 3 API tokens - 2 active tunnels - 5 GB bandwidth / month.

egress.terms: 5 GB bandwidth / month on Registered Free; 512 MiB per tunnel on Anonymous.; ingress: http-only
egress.free_allowance: 5 GB bandwidth / month on Registered Free; 512 MiB per tunnel on Anonymous.

record.chaining: Sits in front of a free VM as a webhook or demo endpoint; no transport for WireGuard.
record.binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the 5 GB monthly allowance is exhausted in under two days (0.0045 TiB), and the free allowance is a hard stop, not a throttle.

identity_cost.detail: No account required for basic usage. The vendor writes: no account required, random ephemeral hostname. Reserving a hostname is free but needs a login.

record.reliability_note: Anonymous hostnames are ephemeral and change per run; the free tier is metered and stops at the allowance.
record.confidence_note: A measured run would confirm whether the 5 GB counts ingress, egress or both; the page does not say.

evidence.proved: Anonymous tier is $0 with 512 MiB per tunnel and no account; Registered Free is 5 GB bandwidth per month with 2 active tunnels; the paid tier is $36/year for 50 GB.
Launch post: lightweight relay-based tunnel service, CLI-first, public relay nodes in North America and Europe, no account required for basic usage.

record.notes: Launched 2026-05-28 on Hacker News and listed on Product Hunt. HTTP-only by construction, so it cannot pass the UDP ingress test regardless of quota.

extras.wg_detail: The relay speaks HTTPS, SSE and WebSocket only. The homepage describes outbound connections with no firewall ports, and no UDP or raw TCP listener is offered.
extras.volume_stated: 5 GB bandwidth / month on Registered Free; 512 MiB per tunnel on Anonymous.
extras.transit_note: The vendor relay carries the bytes over wss://tor1.tunnel.to.
